hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Break the string into contiguous non-overlapping chunks of length k.

hints.title: Optimal Target Chunk
hints.text: To minimize modifications, choose the chunk that already appears most frequently as the target pattern.

hints.title: Calculation
hints.text: Compute total chunks minus the maximum occurrence count of any chunk.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass chunking and frequency tally.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible chunk transformations takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary storage for chunk frequency table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that retaining the most frequent block minimizes replacement operations.
